mark.shape: two overlapping vertical capsules, ink and accent

sm.use: up to 32px — tab icons, inline next to text

usage.inPage: never an svg file for the page chrome — use the BrandMark component (src/components/brand-mark.tsx) so the mark follows the theme
usage.standalone: use the -light file on light backgrounds, the -dark file on dark backgrounds
donts: no third shape, no extra dot or ring
needs clean air — no photos or busy backgrounds behind it
